| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `altru-coder acp` | start ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server |
| `altru-coder mcp` | manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers |
| `altru-coder mcp-server` | run Altru Coder as an MCP server over stdio |
| `altru-coder [project]` | start altru-coder tui |
| `altru-coder attach <url>` | attach to a running altru-coder server |
| `altru-coder run [message..]` | run altru-coder with a message |
| `altru-coder debug` | debugging and troubleshooting tools |
| `altru-coder auth` | manage AI providers and credentials |
| `altru-coder agent` | manage agents |
| `altru-coder upgrade [target]` | upgrade altru-coder to the latest or a specific version |
| `altru-coder uninstall` | uninstall altru-coder and remove all related files |
| `altru-coder serve` | starts a headless altru-coder server |
| `altru-coder models [provider]` | list all available models |
| `altru-coder stats` | show token usage and cost statistics |
| `altru-coder export [sessionID]` | export session data as JSON |
| `altru-coder import <file>` | import session data from JSON file or URL |
| `altru-coder pr <number>` | fetch and checkout a GitHub PR branch, then run altru-coder |
| `altru-coder session` | manage sessions |
| `altru-coder remote` | enable remote connection for real-time session relay |
| `altru-coder db` | database tools |
| `altru-coder config` | configuration tools |
| `altru-coder plugin <module>` | install plugin and update config |
| `altru-coder help [command]` | show full CLI reference |
| `altru-coder completion` | generate shell completion script |
